_about: Control table of the Fiji UI audit (docs/UI_AUDIT.md). Read by tests/ui_audit_tree.groovy (classifies every Swing component of a dialog) and by tests/ui_audit_support.py (checks it, documents it). The FIRST entry that matches a component wins. A component of an interactive class (button, combo box, spinner, slider, text component, list, table, tree) that matches no entry is UNKNOWN and fails ui_fiji_controls_all_known. Fields: id; scope (chooser = the app and tool choosers, form = the tool form); kind (short class name of the Swing class, a text component is JTextComponent); text (the exact button text); label_prefix / label_suffix (of the normalised label: the component's own text, else the label of its row); dialog (app | tool, choosers only); items_open_images (a combo box whose items are all open images); editable (text components); activation (what the audit does, see ui_audit_tree.groovy); effect (what must be true afterwards).
